# Workflow Rerun

We are rerunning this to check the creation of several rds objects from initial run. 

This is largely based on code from: 9_snATAC_snRNA_allSamples_ARC_20230819.Rmd

1. This script starts from merged and processed RNA and ATAC files that have been split already into ARC and PVH:

"arc.combined_111621.rds"
"seuATAC_allSample_ARC.rds"


2. ATAC and RNA data is integrated together to produce a file called:"seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_alSample_ARC.rds"

We think this is equvalent to: "seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_ARC_merge.rds"

3. "seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_ARC_merge.rds" is then subset based on clusters of interest to produce our final object: seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_PVH_merge_subClust.rds

```{r, eval=F}
library(Seurat)
library(Signac)
library(RSpectra)

# Load in RNA and ATAC

seu_rna <- readRDS("../data_objects/arc.combined_111621.RDS")
seu_rna[["clust_snRNA"]] <- seu_rna$seurat_clusters
seu_atac <- readRDS("../data_objects/seuATAC_allSample_ARC.rds")

# basic rna processing
set.seed(1001)
seu_rna[["tech"]] <- "RNA" ## add new meta for tech
DefaultAssay(seu_rna) <- "RNA"
seu_rna <- NormalizeData(seu_rna)
seu_rna <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_rna)
seu_rna <- ScaleData(seu_rna)
seu_rna <- RunPCA(seu_rna,npcs = 50,verbose = FALSE)
ElbowPlot(seu_rna,ndims = 50)
seu_rna <- FindNeighbors(seu_rna,reduction = 'pca',dims = 1:20)
seu_rna <- RunUMAP(seu_rna, dims = 1:20,reduction = 'pca')
seu_rna <- FindClusters(seu_rna)

# basic ATAC processing
DefaultAssay(seu_atac) <- "ATAC"
seu_atac[["tech"]] <- "ATAC"
set.seed(1001)
DefaultAssay(seu_atac) <- "ATAC"
seu_atac <- RunTFIDF(seu_atac)
seu_atac <- FindTopFeatures(seu_atac, min.cutoff = 'q0')
seu_atac <- RunSVD(seu_atac)
seu_atac <- RunUMAP(seu_atac, reduction = 'lsi', 
                      dims = 2:50, reduction.name = "umap.atac", reduction.key = "atacUMAP_")
seu_atac@assays$ATAC@fragments[[1]]@path <- '/rugpfs/fs0/brc/scratch/jluo/snATAC_Han_20230815/snATAC_aggr_WT_OB_Leptin/outs/fragments.tsv.gz'

# get gene activity - quantifying ATAC-seq counts in the 2 kb-upstream region and gene body
gene.activity <- GeneActivity(seu_atac,features = VariableFeatures(seu_rna))
seu_atac[["ACTIVITY"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts=gene.activity)
DefaultAssay(seu_atac) <- "ACTIVITY"
seu_atac <- NormalizeData(seu_atac)
seu_atac <- ScaleData(seu_atac,features = rownames(seu_atac))

# Identify transfer anchors - need these to transfer ids from RNA to ATAC
transfer.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = seu_rna,query = seu_atac,
                                        features = VariableFeatures(seu_rna),
                                        reference.assay = "RNA", query.assay = "ACTIVITY",
                                        reduction = "cca")

# Transfer clusters - use anchors to transfer clustering from RNA to ATAC
clust_pred <- TransferData(anchorset = transfer.anchors, 
                           refdata = seu_rna$seurat_clusters,
                           weight.reduction = seu_atac[["lsi"]], 
                           dims = 2:30)
clust_res <- setNames(clust_pred$predicted.id,rownames(clust_pred))
seu_atac[["clust_snRNA"]] <- clust_res[match(Cells(seu_atac),names(clust_res))]

# Make co-embedding snRNA and snATAC - merges ATAC and RNA
gene.use <- VariableFeatures(seu_rna)
refdata <- GetAssayData(seu_rna,assay = "RNA",slot = "data")[gene.use,]
imputation <- TransferData(anchorset = transfer.anchors, refdata = refdata, 
                           weight.reduction = seu_atac[["lsi"]], dims = 2:30)
seu_atac[["RNA"]] <- imputation
coembed <- merge(x = seu_rna, y = seu_atac)
coembed <- ScaleData(coembed, features = gene.use, do.scale = FALSE)
coembed <- RunPCA(coembed, features = gene.use, verbose = FALSE)
coembed <- FindNeighbors(coembed,reduction = "pca",dims = 1:30,features = gene.use,verbose = FALSE)
coembed <- RunUMAP(coembed, dims = 1:30,reduction = "pca",verbose = FALSE)
coembed <- FindClusters(coembed)

# match clusters
tbl <- table(coembed$seurat_clusters[coembed$tech == "RNA"],
             coembed$clust_snRNA[coembed$tech == "RNA"])

#pheatmap::pheatmap(tbl,scale = "row")
# pheatmap::pheatmap(tbl,scale = "column")

# winner takes all manual assignment of RNA specific clustering information onto merged dataset.
names(table(old_subset$cluster))
# theresult is not a 1:1 to the clusters in the single 
coembed[["cluster"]] <- NA
clust_prop <- list()

coembed$cluster[coembed$seurat_clusters %in% c(0)] <- "5"
clust_prop$c5_0 <- tbl[1,names(tbl[1,])=="5"]/sum(tbl[1,])

coembed$cluster[coembed$seurat_clusters %in% c(1)] <- "3"
```

```{R, eval=F}
# not annotated: 17,24

##
#seu <- readRDS("seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_alSample_ARC.rds")
seu <- coembed

##
## extract information
meta <- seu@meta.data
count <- GetAssayData(seu,assay = "RNA",slot = "data")
count <- as.matrix(count)
clust_atac <- unique(meta$cluster[meta$tech == "ATAC"])
clust_rna <- unique(meta$cluster[meta$tech == "RNA"])
clust_share <- clust_rna[clust_rna %in% clust_atac]
#
mark_ge <- c("Npy","Alk","Dach2","Unc13c","Tmem26","Pomc","Sntb1","Vgll3","Rgs6","Tcf7l2","Sv2b",
             "Col24a1","Pdgfd","Colec12","Megf11","Hydin","Gm20754","Lmo7","Nfib","Mcc","Qrfpr",
             "Pdzrn3","Gem","Ccbe1","Sim1","Bnc2","Sema3e","Lef1","Lhx9")
mark_ge <- mark_ge[mark_ge %in% rownames(count)]
#
calRes_list <- list()
##
## For atac
cell_atac <- rownames(meta)[meta$tech == "ATAC"]
meta_atac <- meta[meta$tech=="ATAC",]
#
calPlot_list <- lapply(c(0:16,18:23),function(clust,ge,mat,meta){
  cell <- rownames(meta)[meta$cluster==clust]
  exp <- mat[ge,cell]
  exp <- rowSums(exp)
  return(exp)},mark_ge,count,meta_atac)
names(calPlot_list) <- c(0:16,18:23)
calPlot_dat <- do.call(cbind,calPlot_list)
calPlot_dat <- calPlot_dat[!matrixStats::rowSds(calPlot_dat) == 0,]
calRes_list[["ATAC"]] <- calPlot_dat
#pheatmap::pheatmap(calPlot_dat,scale = "row",cluster_rows = FALSE,cluster_cols = FALSE)

#   names(exp_list) <- clust
#   exp_mat <- do.call(rbind,exp_list)
#   exp_dat <- data.frame(gene=ge,cluster=rownames(exp_mat),stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
#   exp_dat <- cbind(exp_dat,exp_mat)
#   return(exp_dat)},count,clust_share,meta_atac)
# names(calPlot_list) <- mark_ge
# calPlot_dat <- do.call(rbind,calPlot_list)
# calRes_list[["ATAC"]] <- calPlot_dat
##
## Process snRNA
cell_rna <- rownames(meta)[meta$tech == "RNA"]
meta_rna <- meta[meta$tech=="RNA",]
#
calPlot_list <- lapply(mark_ge,function(ge,mat,clust,meta){
  exp <- mat[ge,]
  exp_list <- lapply(clust,function(x,exp,meta2){
    cell_sel <- rownames(meta2)[meta2$cluster==x]
    ex <- exp[cell_sel]
    to <- length(exp)
    pos <- length(ex[ex > 0])
    med <- mean(ex)
    res <- setNames(c(med,(pos/to)*100),c("exp","prop"))
    return(res)},exp,meta)
  names(exp_list) <- clust
  exp_mat <- do.call(rbind,exp_list)
  exp_dat <- data.frame(gene=ge,cluster=rownames(exp_mat),stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  exp_dat <- cbind(exp_dat,exp_mat)
  return(exp_dat)},count,clust_share,meta_rna)
names(calPlot_list) <- mark_ge
calPlot_dat <- do.call(rbind,calPlot_list)
calPlot_dat$cluster <- factor(calPlot_dat$cluster,levels = c(0:16,18:23))
calRes_list[["RNA"]] <- calPlot_dat
```

# Cluster overlaps

```{r}
test <- merge(data.frame(table(old_object$cluster [old_object$tech =="ATAC"])),data.frame(table(new_object$cluster [new_object$tech =="ATAC"])) , by=1)
colnames(test) <- c("Cluster","Old", "New")
test %>% pivot_longer(cols = 2:3,names_to = "Dataset") %>% ggplot(aes(x = Cluster, y=value, fill=Dataset)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge()) + ggtitle("ATAC cluster overlap")
```

# Subset to remove clusters

- The final object we have been using has certain clusters removed. Lets try doing taht and see if that helps. 

- excluded - 9, 15, 20,21,23/24
- in new - 9, 15, 1(maybe), 20/21, 23

issue: 1 <>

```{R}
new_object$IDs <- names(new_object$orig.ident)

new_subset_temp <- subset(new_object, subset=IDs %in% names(old_subset$cluster))

tbl <- table(old_subset$cluster,
             new_subset_temp$cluster)

pheatmap(tbl, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, scale = "row")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(new_subset_temp, group.by = "cluster", split.by = "tech")
```
```{r}
DimPlot(old_subset_temp, group.by = "cluster", split.by = "tech")
```

Try and use subclustering to rescue cluster 11.

```{r}
new_object <- readRDS("~/Desktop/rds/final_combined_rerun.rds")

new_object@active.ident <- factor(new_object$cluster)

FeaturePlot(new_object, cells=Cells(new_object)[new_object$cluster == 11], split.by = "tech", features = "Bnc2", pt.size = 0.4)

FeaturePlot(new_object, cells=Cells(new_object)[new_object$cluster == 11], split.by = "tech", features = "Lepr", pt.size = 0.4)
```
